_comment: One-off (Nate, 5 Oct): enchantments these characters learned by disenchanting before the server recorded them (alchemy.js rememberLearned, live 4 Oct 04:27Z), proven by the server's own 'disenchant: ... taken' log lines of 2-3 Oct, and Gron #9YT8's gloves on Nate's word (5 Oct; the report reached the server at 18:17:47Z 2 Oct, before it took disenchants) (dry run: claude-nate-release/specs/bugs-1005-ench-restore.json). alchemy.js adds the missing effects to private.dboEnchLearned at the character's next login, once (private.dboEnchRestore = marker), audits ENCH-RESTORE, and the login restore then sends them. Keys are actor ids; the profile must match.
